podcast.body: Nine Inch Nails' sinister, lacerating ballad, penned by industrial rocker Trent Reznor for a 1994 album. This song was famously covered by Johnny Cash in 2003, becoming an iconic "bummer cover" that prompted Reznor to state, "that song isn't mine anymore." "a sinister, lacerating ballad called Hurt, penned by industrial rocker Trent Rezner for a 1994 9-inch nails album."

podcast.body: This song, from "The Downward Spiral" (1994), was among those accused by Mark Anofrio of being plagiarized from his "Elephant Man" compositions. "He says, closer, hurt, march of the pigs, Mr. Self-destruct, and downward spiral are all ripoffs of Elephant Man."
